note: Adjudicated variants: 4 accidental — three of punctuation and one of accent. Substantive text agrees across both witnesses with zero further divergence.

adjudicated.ruling: No comma between the two genitives famulórum famularúmque, with do and with the typical edition: the enclitic que already joins them, and the pair depends on one verb.

Accented, with handmissal-eo and with the same do file's own tuárum in the Meménto of the dead: a word of three syllables carries its stress mark (ORTHOGRAPHY.md). The two editions each drop this accent once, in opposite prayers.
No comma before the et joining the second predicate, with do: fides cógnita est and nota devótio share the one verb.
No comma between pro se and suísque ómnibus, with do: both depend on the same preposition.
